title: Nine Chapters and One Missing Word
subtitle: 描写与说明 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 描写与说明（生活与学习·语言描写与说明）
meta: 主题语境：描写与说明（生活与学习·语言描写与说明）　|　核心词汇：description　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 description 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the clerk ① filed a description that no inspector in the county would have accepted, and he said the filing was the whole of the record. The ② description, meaning the account and not the label, ran nine chapters and stayed unread in the folder; a description, he said, is the only thing in a record that is judged by how long it is left unchecked.

Every ③ description in that folder had the same missing word at the end of it, and the ④ description at the end, meaning the one they kept for the inventory and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked twice. A description, his assistant said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to read; the clerk said the reading is the part that fills nine chapters.

The surveyor meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the description was the whole of the plan, meaning the specification and not the account. The ⑥ description, meaning the specification and not any of that, is the only thing in a plan that everybody signs and nobody reads; description, she said, is either something you file or the only word that means both an account and a specification. She said the specification is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ description had become a line in an index, and the index had become an argument about the missing word. The ⑧ description of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in August, was one folder and nine chapters of reading; description, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to read. She said the reading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ description I remember is the one at the end, which was corrected in 1975 and is still described as the fullest in the folder. A ⑩ description, the assistant said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being checked; every description, she said, is a specification that has agreed to look like an account. She said the specification was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 描述；描写（指卷宗里归档的那一份）
B. n. 描述（指那份记述本身，与那个标签相对）
C. 固定搭配：file a description 归档一份描述
D. n. 描述（指留给清单用的那一份）
E. n. 描述；说明（抽象总称，指一个卷宗里的全部记述）
F. n. 描述（指索引里写到、被编目的那一份）
G. n. 规格说明；说明书（指规划里被签署的那份技术要求）
H. n. 规格说明（抽象总称，指人人签字却无人细读的那份）

items.q: filed a description that no inspector in the county would have accepted
The description, meaning the account and not the label
the description was the whole of the plan
the description had become a line in an index
The description of the whole thing
A description, the assistant said in 1977

answers.why: file a description 意为“归档一份描述”，1953 年办事员归档了一份全县没有一位视察员肯接受的描述。
description 意为“描述”，指那份记述本身而不是那个标签，它长达九章而始终没人读。
description 意为“描述”，指那个卷宗里每一份描述，每一份末尾都有同一个缺失的词。
description 意为“描述”，指留给清单用的那一份，是唯一有人核对过两次的。
description 意为“规格说明、说明书”，指规划里被签署的那份技术要求，测量员说这份说明就是那项规划的全部。
description 意为“规格说明”，指人人签字却无人细读的那份而不是那份记述本身，是规划里人人都签字、却无人细读的东西。
description 意为“描述”，指索引里写到、被编目的那一份，到 1961 年这份描述成了索引里的一行。
description 意为“描述、说明”，办事员八月写道，整件事的记述是一个卷宗和九章的阅读。
description 意为“描述”，我记得的是末尾那一份，1975 年被更正，至今仍被说成卷宗里最完整的一份。
description 为抽象总称，助手 1977 年说，一份描述是唯一会因为被核对而变得更好的东西。
